propositions: code_health metric is currently coupled to Python and rebar-specific tooling, making it non-portable to non-Python client projects

rebar metrics hardcode project-specific paths and artifacts (src/rebar, .github/module-size-limit.txt) and fabricate zeros or leak exceptions when those paths are absent instead of reporting Unavailable
code analyzer should be implemented as a configurable interface backed by polyglot OSS tools (scc, lizard, jscpd) and shipped as an optional [metrics] pip extra to keep rebar core dependency-free
per-project configuration must replace hardcoded scanning logic, allowing clients to specify analyzer tool and thresholds independently of rebar governance
missing or unconfigured analyzer for a project language must return honest Unavailable with clear reason rather than fabricated metrics or uncaught errors
module-size cap policy should be re-expressed as an optional policy layer over generic LOC signal instead of hardcoded logic
